query:
SELECT 
  sl.id,
  sl.contestId,
  sl.entryNumber,
  sl.predictedScore,
  sl.actualScore,
  sl.status,
  sl.isWinningLineup,
  sl.createdAt,
  c.name as contestName,
  c.contestStatus,
  c.rarityRestriction,
  c.format,
  c.entries,
  c.maxEntries,
  c.startDate,
  c.endDate
FROM saved_lineups sl
LEFT JOIN contests c ON sl.contestId = c.id
ORDER BY sl.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 30;
